info.title: Burrow API
info.description: Initial contract for the stable Burrow REST surface. This is a contract layer over the existing implementation; streaming and provider-specific event protocols remain documented separately. Model discovery can enrich provider/model ID matches from a cached models.dev catalog; Azure training-date suffixes are removed before exact model lookup. Provider metadata and manual overrides take precedence; catalog failure preserves unknown/existing metadata. Enriched model objects may expose capabilityProvenance {source, snapshotAt, matchedProvider, matchedModel}, discoveredContextWindow, optional contextWindowOverride, and effective contextWindow. No provider credentials or private deployment data are sent to models.dev.

Cancel queued or held input, or request cancellation of running input. Cancelling a running queue_next input holds the whole main queue; cancelling a side question does not. A terminal input is returned unchanged.
Requires an input currently held in the selected session and generation; clears the session hold and resumes all held queue_next inputs in FIFO order. Does not restart a cancelled input.

get.description: Runtime-owned minion ancestry. Session/root selection is agent-scoped, includes descendants and necessary ended ancestors in parent-first order, and excludes siblings when a child is requested. Live children can be recovered from session metadata when subagent records have been retained away. Explicit root markers retain honest orphan descendants without inventing a parent or turning a child into a depth-zero root. Child maxDepth is the saved spawn-time budget, while root maxDepth is the current setting; these fields are observability, not authorization.

post.description: Supplying the exact agentId of an active main run stops that run and holds its session main queue, including future queue_next submissions, until explicitly resumed. Omitting agentId uses legacy unique-run lookup but does not establish the queue hold. Stopping a side question does not hold the main queue.

get.description: Page complete agent/local-day groups across enabled and disabled agents, newest local day then agent ID descending. Each group combines real diaries (by createdAt) and retained Dream cycle receipts (by startedAt, falling back to createdAt then generatedAt); failure-only days remain visible. A matching search returns the whole group, not only matching entries. Phase attempts, unattributed cycle failures/running progress and diaries are separate; only an explicit diaryId is recorded as a link, and it may refer to a diary outside this group or no longer retained. No link is inferred from phase or day. Errors are sanitized; owner metadata, provider responses and receipt graphs are not returned.

post.description: Return registered agents with identities, requested-session/descendant status, context usage, and model selections in one request. The optional sessions map selects each agent’s session. Status uses the same runtime-owned ancestry as /api/agent-status, including metadata-only live descendants and honest orphans. Context inspection is bounded to the requested session plus 12 descendants per agent; contextHydration.truncated reports omitted contexts, not a truncated status tree. Opt in to agent-wide minions with minionScope: agent (session is the default). status.minionScope: agent confirms a successful all-origin scan for that agent; disabled/error entries do not claim coverage. The anchor session and its activity remain independent. Ordinary unrelated chats are not minions; requested child anchors retain depth and appear once. Depth-two orphans without root metadata keep unknown roots. Context hydration remains bounded to the anchor plus 12 distinct minion sessions; session recovery and cancellation stay scoped.

sessions.description: Optional mapping of registered agent IDs to requested anchor sessions.

minionScope.description: Session subtree (default) or visible minions across all originating sessions of each agent.

post.summary: Redeem one selected native OpenAI banked reset credit
post.description: Refreshes native credits, validates the selected credit, then sends exactly one redemption POST. Reuse requestId when reconciling an uncertain result; do not blindly retry using a new ID. Process-local account guard and request ledger prevent concurrent/replayed redemption. Success includes usageRefresh and creditsRefresh; their failures do not mean redemption failed. Ambiguous failures return ambiguous:true and require refresh/reconciliation.

get.summary: Rolling native OpenAI LB request and attempt metrics
get.description: Completed logical native openai-lb requests over rolling 24h and 7d windows. Failover success is one success. Cancellations count in requests but not failures. errorPercent = 100 * failures / requests (null when empty). Token sums include all attempts with reported usage; unknown totals are null, not zero. cachePercent = 100 * sum(cached) / sum(input) only on attempts where both are known; null for no positive known denominator. coverage reports known attempt counts and that denominator. Unfinished/interrupted requests are excluded. No provider payloads or credentials. Requires diagnostics:read for API tokens.

post.summary: Preview final DreamMemory synthesis without persistence
post.description: Explicit POST only. Uses recent validated extracted candidates from existing Dream extraction checkpoints, revalidated against current eligible REM-window source identities; not all history and not new extraction. No writes to memories, settings, preferences, extraction coverage, diary entries, or cycles. Empty candidates return empty memories without a model call. The bounded server-side source snapshot is agent-bound, expires after 15 minutes, and is invalidated by restart. Repeating a sourceToken preserves candidate sources, but model output can vary. Citation validation, model resolution, and prompt budgeting reuse final synthesis.

200.description: Transient preview; persisted is always false

400.description: Validation, invalid token, model resolution, or prompt budget error. Invalid, expired, or wrong-agent sourceToken returns dream_memory_preview_source_token_invalid.

post.summary: Receive signed GitHub workflow completion webhook
post.description: Independent of normal UI auth. Requires an effective secret configured in Settings or through the optional higher-priority BURROW_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment override and HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw body in X-Hub-Signature-256; 256 KiB maximum raw body. X-GitHub-Event: ping returns 200 after signature and JSON validation; non-workflow_run or non-completed actions return 202 with zero events. Completed workflow_run requires the fields in GithubWorkflowCompletedPayload, including consistent repository/workflow identities, exact GitHub URL and valid timestamp. Matching is by enabled watch repository + exact workflow name; each run ID + attempt + watch is stored once. A 202 returns only per-watch {id, accepted} receipts plus accepted/duplicates counts: durable acceptance, not execution success. Full retained event rows are available only from normally UI-authorized GET /api/events. See docs/event-triggered-work.md.

type.description: MIME type. image/* or a data:image URL is treated as an image attachment.

encoding.description: utf8/plain text or a data URL/base64 representation.

content.description: Inline text or data URL. Non-image content is accepted up to 200000 characters before prompt budgeting. Image content is accepted up to 30000000 characters.

ChatStreamEvent.description: NDJSON events include nonterminal model.recovery activity; see chat-stream-contract.md. Only run.completed/run.failed/run.cancelled/run.superseded are terminal.

version.description: Calendar release identifier; same-day revisions append -N.

lane.description: Execution lane, independent of the source field.

inputId.description: Present for a run originating from a durable chat input.

source.description: Origin of the run, such as queue_next, side_question, or another registered run source.

parentSessionId.description: Immediate owning session, not the root; null for a root. A retained-away parent is not fabricated.

parentRunId.description: Immediate owning run ID when recorded; null for a root.

subagentId.description: Runtime-owned child identity when recorded; null for a root or unavailable historical identity.

depth.description: Root is 0, direct children are 1, grandchildren are 2. Historical children without a depth marker remain depth 1.

maxDepth.description: Current agent setting for a depth-zero root; SAVED spawn-time lineage budget for a child (historical default 1), not its recalculated effective spawn permission.

rootSessionId.description: Saved root session marker, or ancestry-derived root when available. Distinct from the immediate parent; may be null when unavailable.

rootRunId.description: Saved root run marker, or ancestry-derived root run when available; null when unavailable.

subagents.description: Scoped descendant tree including ended ancestors needed by visible/live descendants. Includes metadata-only live children when durable records are absent.

McpLifecycle.description: ephemeral starts a fresh MCP server per call. keep_alive retains one server process and its state across calls; use it for stateful servers such as browser automation.

availability.description: Mod-owned tools only. Ordinary MCP tools always require agent grants.

apiKey.description: Optional replacement API key. Stored encrypted and never returned.

environmentVariables.description: Provider-scoped environment variables for a stdio MCP. Values are encrypted; omitted values retain existing entries while editing, and omitted entries are removed.

headers.description: HTTP headers, encrypted and never returned. Omit to preserve all; supplied map defines retained names; null preserves an existing case-insensitive name (error if absent); {} clears. Names are case-insensitive and duplicates rejected; values reject CR/LF/NUL and are limited to 8192 UTF-8 bytes. Explicit Authorization overrides legacy Bearer apiKey. Not sent to stdio providers.

headerNames.description: Configured lowercase HTTP header names only; never values.

ArchiveSessionListResponse.description: Human-facing archive only. Reset snapshots are virtual documents with archiveSnapshot=reset and sourceSessionId; they never enter normal agent session, context, recall, continuity, or search paths.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to retrieve the next page.

ArchiveSessionResponse.description: Archive-only chat conversation reader. Newest page first; before selects older pages. Compacted generations are deduplicated by stable turn ID; reset snapshots remain separate. Missing retained generations and stale cursors return 409 rather than implying beginning of history.

session.description: Session detail with turns containing only visible chat messages, ordered chronologically within this page; attachment references remain in message content.

password.description: Required when any selected category contains secrets or sensitive content.

RunEvidenceInspection.description: Bounded provenance-only inspection metadata. Evidence text, tool output, and provider bodies are excluded.

ContextBuildReceipt.description: Receipt for the last assembled provider prompt; contains bounded inspection metadata, not prompt text or provider bodies.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to retrieve the next page.

excerpt.description: Trimmed first 320 characters of retained diary Markdown.

ArchiveDreamDiary.description: Actual retained diary narrative, without source references or model/runtime metadata.

entryDate.description: Diary entry date; not the local creation day used to group records.

ArchiveDreamPhaseErrors.description: Present diagnostic stages have bounded, redacted error text.

ArchiveDreamPhaseAttempt.description: Receipt phase evidence. A retry failure does not invalidate an earlier diary.

error.description: First sanitized phase error, if any.

startedAt.description: Explicitly recorded phase start, not inferred from cycle timing.

completedAt.description: Explicitly recorded phase completion, not inferred from cycle timing.

runStartedAt.description: Cycle start, falling back to receipt createdAt then generatedAt.

diaryId.description: Explicit receipt diary ID only; may identify a diary outside this group or no longer retained. No association is inferred from matching day or phase.

ArchiveDreamCycleAttempt.description: Unattributed cycle-level failure/interruption or running progress; not assigned to a phase.

error.description: Sanitized unattributed cycle error, if any.

ArchiveDreamPhaseDetail.description: Real diaries and receipt phase attempts remain separate; only an explicit diaryId records a link, which need not resolve within this group.

ArchiveDreamGroupSummary.description: One whole agent/local-day group; list counts cover all retained evidence in that group.

day.description: Local creation day in timezone, not diary entryDate.

timezone.description: Resolved IANA timezone used for grouping.

createdAt.description: Latest diary or receipt creation timestamp within the group.

ArchiveDreamGroup.description: Retained diary, phase-attempt and unattributed cycle evidence for one agent/local day, including nonstandard phase diaries. Cycle attempts are only unattributed failures/interruption or running progress, not every receipt.

day.description: Local creation day in timezone, not diary entryDate.

timezone.description: Resolved IANA timezone used for grouping.

createdAt.description: Latest diary or receipt creation timestamp within the group.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page with the same filters; null when there is no next page.

ArchiveWorkflowEvent.description: GitHub completion-event snapshot and provenance captured at acceptance. ownerId and traceDir are omitted; result is redacted. instruction and error remain retained text.

url.description: GitHub Actions run URL validated against repository and run ID.

status.description: pending/running are outstanding; succeeded/failed are terminal; interrupted is retained for reconciliation, not blindly replayed. Webhook receipt accepted=true means only durable acceptance, not handled.

result.description: Retained runtime result, which may be any JSON value (including null); recursively redacted and traversal-bounded for the Archive projection. Redaction is boundary-based, not a guarantee that arbitrary free-text secrets are removed.

agentName.description: Current agent name, falling back to agentId.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page with the same filters; null when there is no next page.

title.description: Deterministically derived archive title when available.

summary.description: Optional one- or two-sentence model summary. Null when no archive-summary model is configured or generation did not succeed.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to retrieve the next page.
Pass as cursor to retrieve the next page.

SessionTurn.description: Bounded chat or activity entry returned by the session detail endpoint. Tool calls and results remain debug/audit records and are represented to the UI through SessionToolActivity, not raw tool payloads.

SessionToolActivity.description: Structured, displayable tool activity for a parent or child session. It contains bounded labels and outcomes, not raw tool arguments or result payloads.

ArchiveRunDetail.description: Bounded operator-readable proof packet assembled from persisted runtime receipts, activities, final chat output, and run evidence. Raw tool artifacts remain trace-owned.

request.description: Exact canonical user message that initiated this run, when retained.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to retrieve the next page.

summary.description: Plain-language explanation of the recorded context and compression state.

contextEvents.description: Bounded recorded context-build decisions for this run.

attachmentManifest.description: All attachment references retained by the context build.

currentAttachmentManifest.description: Attachments supplied on the current request.

retainedAttachmentManifest.description: Prior attachment references retained across context rebuilding.

SessionExportEntry.description: One normalized canonical persisted session record. This is an export/audit record, not the bounded UI session-turn projection.

SessionExport.description: Schema-versioned, read-only canonical transcript export. Compacted transcript generations are included; reset snapshots remain separate archive resources.

SessionListItem.description: Stable session discovery record for incremental export polling.

ModContributions.description: Validated declarative host contribution contracts declared by a loaded mod. Core owns Settings rendering/layout; mods declare data capabilities and metadata.

apiTargets.description: Mod-scoped endpoint implementing the API target registry contract. Core resolves and manages these targets through its existing UI and API clients.

settings.description: Core-rendered Settings workspace slots declared by the mod. Legacy apiTargets remains available as a generic fallback.

ui.description: Optional installed-mod UI assets. settingsUrl identifies a settings module loaded through the host-owned Settings runtime contract; controlUrl remains the legacy control surface.

value.description: Optional replacement value. Stored encrypted and never returned; omit it while editing to retain an already configured value.

configured.description: Whether an encrypted value is stored. The value is never returned.

capability.description: Settings capability supplied by the installed mod and rendered through the host-owned Settings contract.

ModSettingsContribution.description: Declarative mod Settings slot. Core owns Settings layout and rendering; the mod declares labels, optional inventory metadata, and host-owned data capabilities.

intervalMs.description: Base delay between background source refreshes in milliseconds.

staleMs.description: Age in milliseconds after which listing management state queues a refresh.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of independent Git sources checked concurrently; defaults to 4 when not configured.

maxBackoffMs.description: Maximum background retry delay after refresh failures; defaults to 24 hours when not configured.

BrainEmbeddingSelection.description: Global Brains-only selection of existing encrypted model connection. No new credential fields. Enabling requires connectionId and embedding model. Disabled by default.

repository.description: Generic HTTPS/SSH Git URL or absolute local repository path; credentials must not be embedded.

path.description: Repository-relative SKILL.md or directory; . selects root.

cron.description: Existing five-field cron; required when enabled.

timezone.description: Deprecated compatibility field; accepted and ignored. All schedules use operator_timezone.

id.description: Optional skill ID; defaults to suggestedId derived from fetched name.

expectedRevision.description: Optional preview revision; mismatch rejects import with 409 skill_revision_changed.

suffix.description: Trimmed suffix appended to the default Burrow document title; empty restores the default title.
Suffix to trim before enforcing the 80-character stored-value limit; whitespace-only input clears the suffix.

memberConnectionIds.description: Ordered existing same-family OAuth connection IDs. Nested pools are forbidden.

apiType.description: Provider protocol, including openai-lb and anthropic-lb for logical OAuth pools.

ModelConnectionWrite.description: Pool connections require pool, forbid credentials, and expose the union of matching OAuth member models. Non-pool connections require an HTTP(S) baseUrl.

DreamSettingsUpdate.description: Partial Dream settings update; omitted fields retain saved values. Read-only default/effective memory prompts are not writable controls.

timezone.description: Legacy input accepted but ignored; the operator timezone is authoritative.

prompt.description: Dream diary prompt, independent of final DreamMemory synthesis controls.

memoryEmphasis.description: Final DreamMemory synthesis emphasis. This does not change raw extraction or diary generation.

memoryPromptOverride.description: Optional final DreamMemory synthesis prompt override; null selects the built-in default. Independent of the diary prompt.

DreamSettings.description: Per-agent Dream settings with resolved, read-only memory prompt and operator timezone.

timezone.description: Legacy input accepted but ignored; the operator timezone is authoritative.

prompt.description: Dream diary prompt, independent of final DreamMemory synthesis controls.

memoryEmphasis.description: Final DreamMemory synthesis emphasis. This does not change raw extraction or diary generation.

memoryPromptOverride.description: Optional final DreamMemory synthesis prompt override; null selects the built-in default. Independent of the diary prompt.

effectiveMemoryPrompt.description: Saved memoryPromptOverride when set; otherwise defaultMemoryPrompt.

effectiveModel.description: Resolved Dream model without persisting inherited selection.

DreamMemoryPreviewRequest.description: Transient overrides only; omitted fields use saved settings. An empty object previews saved settings.

memoryEmphasis.description: Omitted uses the saved emphasis (whose default is 50).

memoryPromptOverride.description: Omitted uses the saved override; null selects the built-in default for this preview only.

sourceToken.description: Opaque token returned by an earlier preview for this agent. Reuses its candidate source snapshot; expires after 15 minutes and is invalidated by restart.

memories.description: Generated, citation-validated memories; empty candidates return an empty array without a model call.

sourceToken.description: Opaque agent-bound server-side snapshot token. Repeat previews preserve candidate sources, not model output.

sourceCount.description: Number of distinct cited source messages in the snapshot.

evidenceScope.description: Recent validated extracted candidates from existing Dream extraction checkpoints, revalidated against current eligible REM-window source identities; not all history and not new extraction.
evidenceScope.example: Recent validated extracted candidates from existing Dream extraction checkpoints, revalidated against current eligible REM-window source identities; not all history and not new extraction.

persisted.description: Preview never persists memory, settings, preferences, extraction coverage, diary entries, or cycles.

id.description: Optional existing watch UUID to update; omitted creates a new watch.

workflow.description: GitHub workflow_run.name; exact case-sensitive match against the configured workflow name, not file path.

sessionId.description: Dedicated session for this agent and release watch; customize for independent work lanes.

instruction.description: Operator-authored standing instruction. Webhook payload fields are untrusted context, not new instructions.

CompletionEvent.description: Full retained event snapshot with agent/session authority captured when accepted. Returned by normally UI-authorized GET /api/events, never by the signed webhook acknowledgment.

url.description: GitHub Actions run URL validated against repository and run ID.

status.description: pending/running are outstanding; succeeded/failed are terminal; interrupted is retained for reconciliation, not blindly replayed. Webhook receipt accepted=true means only durable acceptance, not handled.

result.description: Runtime result JSON (including null) captured when handled.

CompletionEventReceipt.description: Minimal per-watch webhook acknowledgment; no retained event snapshot, watch instruction, agent/session identifiers or run/trace fields are exposed by the webhook.

accepted.description: True for newly accepted events; false for a previously accepted duplicate. Neither value proves execution.

GithubWorkflowCompletedPayload.description: Relevant fields in GitHub workflow_run delivery. Other GitHub fields are accepted. A signed ping may instead contain a different JSON object.

GithubWebhookAcceptResponse.description: The webhook acknowledgment projects only id and accepted for each matching watch; full event rows require the normally UI-authorized GET /api/events route.

events.description: Minimal per-watch receipts only; never event snapshots.

accepted.description: Count newly accepted for enabled matching watches.

duplicates.description: Count of matching previously accepted watch/run/attempt snapshots.

CompletionEventSettingsPatch.description: Partial update. No plaintext secret readback. Nonblank secret with clearSecret=true is invalid.

deliveryUrl.description: Optional delivery URL metadata, trimmed on save; empty clears it. If nonempty, absolute http(s) URL with path exactly /api/events/github, without username, password, query or fragment. Does not change routing or prove reachability.

secret.description: At most 8192 UTF-8 bytes; no CR, LF or NUL. Blank or whitespace-only preserves the existing stored secret exactly; nonblank stores the exact provided bytes encrypted using the managed credentials key. Nonblank and clearSecret=true are rejected.

clearSecret.description: True explicitly clears only the stored secret, not any environment override.

deliveryUrl.description: Optional configured delivery URL metadata; empty when unset.

secretConfigured.description: Whether an effective secret is configured, including an unavailable stored secret.

storedSecretConfigured.description: Whether a stored secret is configured, even if unavailable.

environmentOverride.description: True when the optional nonempty environment secret takes precedence.

ready.description: Local signature verification readiness only; not public reachability or agent-handling proof.

readiness.description: secret_unavailable means the stored secret cannot be decrypted (for example corrupt data or wrong key), unless an environment override is active. The webhook returns 503 when the effective secret is missing or unavailable.

ChatInputRequest.description: Supply a nonblank message or an inline attachment. A side question needs message text for its answer and an exact active main targetRunId. The client should send the current generation.

agentId.description: Selected agent; omit to use the server-selected agent.

intent.description: Explicit intent. No inference or fallback to steering or a different intent.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable client-generated key for retries, scoped to agent, session, and generation.

generation.description: Session reset generation. Optional for compatibility; clients should send the generation returned by GET to fence stale actions.

targetRunId.description: Required for a new side_question; exact currently active main run in this agent and session. An idempotent retry can replay after that run ends.

message.description: User text. A side question with no message text can be accepted if it has an attachment, but its side execution fails.

attachments.description: Inline attachments normalized as for chat. Current side-question attachments use normal text/native-image handling; historical attachments in a snapshot are only represented by manifest counts.

promotedFrom.description: Optional succeeded side_question input ID in the same agent/session/generation; the operator supplies edited text/attachments explicitly.

ChatInputActionRequest.description: Select the same agent and session as the input. Clients should send the generation returned by GET to fence reset races.

generation.description: Session reset generation. Optional for compatibility; clients should send the generation returned by GET to fence stale actions.

ChatInputAttachment.description: Normalized inline attachment included in the public input record, including content.

ChatInputSnapshotMetadata.description: Immutable header of the original side-question snapshot. The raw captured conversation and profile are not returned.

ChatInputResult.description: Terminal runner projection; acceptance is not success.

ChatInput.description: Public durable chat input; snapshot is metadata only, while submitted message and normalized attachments are returned.

cancelRequested.description: For running work, cancellation is requested before terminal status is recorded.

position.description: 1-based FIFO position among queued/held main inputs, otherwise null.

inputs.description: All held inputs transitioned by this resume, in accepted order.

ModelFailure.description: Curated producer-proven failure origin. Not provider/error prose. retryable denotes eligibility, not permission to replay tools.

OtelDestinationConnection.description: Nonsecret provider connection fields. Direct is the default for Datadog and Splunk; site/realm do not synthesize endpoints.

organization.description: OpenObserve organization used when deriving an /api/<organization> base.

mode.description: Only for Datadog and Splunk; blank behaves like direct.

verify.description: Verify the HTTPS server certificate. Custom CA material belongs in write-only credentials.caCertificate.

OtelDestinationCredentials.description: Write-only fields encrypted at rest. For the same ID and provider, omitted or empty-string fields preserve the saved values; nonempty fields replace individual values.

token.description: Provider credential token or full OpenObserve Authorization value.

caCertificate.description: Custom CA PEM for this destination.

OtelDestinationInput.description: One operator-owned destination. Enabled rows need at least one supported signal and a URL for each enabled signal. Mode/signal/temporality constraints are provider-specific; see docs/otel-destination-contract.md. Direct Datadog and Splunk require exact URLs for enabled signals.

name.description: Nonempty display name, at most 160 characters after trimming.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL; enabled signals derive /v1/traces or /v1/metrics when no exact URL is provided. HTTP(S) without userinfo, query or fragment; empty is allowed.

tracesEndpoint.description: Exact OTLP/HTTP trace URL; no signal path is appended. HTTP(S) without userinfo, query or fragment; empty is allowed.

metricsEndpoint.description: Exact OTLP/HTTP metric URL; no signal path is appended. HTTP(S) without userinfo, query or fragment; empty is allowed.

metricsEnabled.description: Provider-dependent default; Tempo, Jaeger, and direct Splunk do not support metrics.

headers.description: Comma-separated OTLP key=value pairs. Omitted or blank preserves the same ID/provider value; explicit case-insensitive names override provider headers.

clearHeaders.description: True removes stored headers and cannot be combined with headers.

clearCredentials.description: True removes all saved credential fields and cannot be combined with credentials.

name.description: Nonempty display name, at most 160 characters after trimming.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP base URL; enabled signals derive /v1/traces or /v1/metrics when no exact URL is provided. HTTP(S) without userinfo, query or fragment; empty is allowed.

tracesEndpoint.description: Exact OTLP/HTTP trace URL; no signal path is appended. HTTP(S) without userinfo, query or fragment; empty is allowed.

metricsEndpoint.description: Exact OTLP/HTTP metric URL; no signal path is appended. HTTP(S) without userinfo, query or fragment; empty is allowed.

metricsEnabled.description: Provider-dependent default; Tempo, Jaeger, and direct Splunk do not support metrics.

credentialsConfigured.description: Whether any credential field is configured.

credentialFields.description: Names of configured credential fields; values are never returned.

legacy.description: True only for an existing scalar single-endpoint configuration projected as a destination; its provider was never recorded. False for authoritative saved destinations and environment transport. Display metadata only, not inferred from id/name/endpoint and not accepted in PUT. The first successful destination-list save adopts the entry and returns false. An unchanged ID/provider preserves omitted secrets; changing the provider intentionally discards the former secrets.

OtelDestinationPublic.description: Safe saved or effective destination; contains no protected values.

OtelProviderMetadata.description: Provider preset, not verification of a hosted connection. Splunk metrics are collector-only.

OtelLegacySettingsInput.description: Legacy scalar form. A non-equivalent saved destination list returns 409 instead of being discarded.

endpoint.description: Legacy OTLP/HTTP base URL without userinfo, query or fragment. May be empty when disabled.

headers.description: Replacement OTLP headers. Blank or omitted preserves the existing value.

clearHeaders.description: True removes saved headers; cannot be combined with headers.

OtelDestinationSettingsInput.description: Atomically replace the complete list. IDs must be unique. When master enabled is true at least one destination must be enabled; an empty list is allowed when disabled.

endpoint.description: Legacy scalar projection of the saved list.
Legacy scalar projection of the effective transport.

destinations.description: Environment endpoint/header overrides replace saved transport with one effective environment destination.

OtelExportFailure.description: Safe category, numeric HTTP status and bounded partial-success rejection count when known; never raw collector text.

OtelRuntimeStatus.description: Safe aggregate and per-destination runtime status; delivery does not prove hosted ingestion.

MinionMaxDepth.description: Maximum nesting from the depth-zero root. 0 disables spawning; 1 permits direct children; 2 also permits grandchildren. The spawn tool is absent at an allowed leaf.

AgentMinionSettingsUpdate.description: The only supported minion setting is maxDepth. It is required even though the default for an unset agent is 1; unknown fields do not create additional settings.

AgentStatusEntry.description: Runtime-owned minion ancestry. Session/root selection is agent-scoped, includes descendants and necessary ended ancestors in parent-first order, and excludes siblings when a child is requested. Live children can be recovered from session metadata when subagent records have been retained away. Explicit root markers retain honest orphan descendants without inventing a parent or turning a child into a depth-zero root. Child maxDepth is the saved spawn-time budget, while root maxDepth is the current setting; these fields are observability, not authorization.

runId.description: Current registered run ID when live; saved child run ID when available, otherwise null.

parentSessionId.description: Immediate owning session, not the root; null for a root. A retained-away parent is not fabricated.

parentRunId.description: Immediate owning run ID when recorded; null for a root.

subagentId.description: Runtime-owned child identity when recorded; null for a root or unavailable historical identity.

depth.description: Root is 0, direct children are 1, grandchildren are 2. Historical children without a depth marker remain depth 1.

maxDepth.description: Current agent setting for a depth-zero root; SAVED spawn-time lineage budget for a child (historical default 1), not its recalculated effective spawn permission.

rootSessionId.description: Saved root session marker, or ancestry-derived root when available. Distinct from the immediate parent; may be null when unavailable.

rootRunId.description: Saved root run marker, or ancestry-derived root run when available; null when unavailable.

Live children can be recovered from session metadata when subagent records have been retained away. Explicit root markers retain honest orphan descendants without inventing a parent or turning a child into a depth-zero root. Child maxDepth is the saved spawn-time budget, while root maxDepth is the current setting; these fields are observability, not authorization.

parentSessionId.description: Immediate owning session, not the root; null for a root. A retained-away parent is not fabricated.

depth.description: Root is 0, direct children are 1, grandchildren are 2. Historical children without a depth marker remain depth 1.

rootSessionId.description: Saved root session marker, or ancestry-derived root when available. Distinct from the immediate parent; may be null when unavailable.

rootRunId.description: Saved root run marker, or ancestry-derived root run when available; null when unavailable.

GithubWebhookSignature.name: X-Hub-Signature-256
GithubWebhookSignature.description: sha256=<64 hexadecimal digits>: HMAC-SHA256 over the exact raw request bytes using the effective Settings secret or optional BURROW_GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET environment override. Not a UI session, bearer token, or literal API key. Recompute for each delivery; do not paste the secret here.
